name: Shimizu (Hokkaido, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Shimizu town emblem in white and red: a white six-pointed star of blades bearing a red star with the character 清.
history: Municipal flag of Shimizu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 8 May 1937.

features.role: Shimizu town emblem — a white six-pointed star of blades bearing a red star with the character 清
